impact: Explicit CSS width strings are emitted unchanged, but every non-em value is approximated as ten em during overflow and fit calculations. The resulting colgroup can receive an incorrect fit class or page-scaling decision even though CSS-length inputs are documented as supported. Supported units and accounting need one deterministic contract.
resolution: Resolved by T-005 (ee1d390). Explicit automatic-width overrides now use the ratified positive finite numeric/decimal-em grammar, normalize idempotently without precision loss at float accounting precision, and are fitted and emitted from the same em values. The obsolete non-em ten-em fallback was removed; exact boundary, mixed-column, orientation, aggregate-overflow, and fixed-only overflow behavior is covered by the passing test suite.
title: Non-em explicit widths use incorrect overflow accounting
